data.one_liner: Windows implementation of the file_selector plugin
data.what_it_does: Provides the Windows-specific implementation for the file_selector plugin, allowing apps to select and save files and directories on Windows.
use_when: You are building a Flutter desktop application for Windows using file_selector
You need to implement native file open and save dialogs on Windows
avoid_when: You are targeting non-Windows platforms exclusively
You are using the endorsed file_selector package directly without needing direct Windows package APIs
strengths: Endorsed plugin that integrates automatically when using file_selector
data.setup_notes: Automatically included when using the endorsed file_selector package.
